title: Absolute Love Enforcement The Reason Why a Female Soldier Became The Beloved Character in Her New Life
description: Read manga Absolute Love Enforcement The Reason Why a Female Soldier Became The Beloved Character in Her New Life , 絶対レンアイ強制力～女兵士が転生先で愛され役になった訳 , Zettai Renai Kyousei Ryoku ~ Onna Heishi ga Tensei Saki de Aisare Yaku ni Natta Wake In a world where humans are called to fight the gods, Louise is a female soldier who fought on the front lines. She is fatally wounded and dies in the arms of Erich, a soldier with whom she has a bitter rivalry. At that moment, Erich asks God for something, but Louise fails to hear him. –And so, Louise is reincarnated into a world that is the polar opposite of her previous life, a peaceful world like a romance novel! Everyone is obsessed with love, and there is even a mysterious power that creates predictable plot developments…!? Louise is proposed to by a man who looks just like Erich…! –Why was Louise reincarnated into such a world? A new life full of romance begins!
